title.narrative: 08 Jun 2020 | Video: https://www.adb.org/news/videos/bringing-better-transport-solutions-yerevan
Loan 2752: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 03 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Two civil works contracts are completed for two southern road links of Yerevan bypass.
Design for two overpasses on Arshakunyats street are finalized. Decision on implementation and technical solutions of the flyovers are under discussion by the municipal government with intention to tender out by Q2 2019.
New public transport network has been developed and planned to be implemented by the Yerevan Municipality in 2019. Delays are expected because of the political changes in the municipal and central government.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Nov 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42417/42417-023-apfs-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | May 2014: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//42417-023-eia-04.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Dec 2015: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42417-023-iee-01_0.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Dec 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42417/42417-023-rp-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Social Compliance Audit Report | Jun 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42417/42417-023-scar-en.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42417/42417-023-smr-en_11.pdf
